name: print-social-navy-fintech-portrait-ads-with-serif-italic-and-laurel
title: Navy Portrait Ads with Card and Laurel
whatItIs: Two portrait ads: a woman in a navy sweater holding a card over one eye against navy, with a wordmark, a #1 laurel with 4.9 stars and an Explore now button; and a pale panel with 'Move smarter.' in sans and italic serif beside a hand using a card terminal.
whatItMeans: Clothing that matches the brand blue makes photos feel designed, and the laurel adds trust.
techniques: Model dressed in the brand colour
Card held over the eye as a playful gesture
Laurel badge with rating for trust
Italic serif word in a sans headline
Cropped close-up of a terminal in the second ad

vocabulary.definition: A wreath around a ranking or rating.
Clothing chosen to match brand colours.
A tight crop of a device in use.
